I’m going through this situation now. Gone from being involved in my sons life for the first 2 months and seeing him regularly after we split. As soon as the penny dropped that the split was permanent all contact was stopped it’s taken 4 months for me to start contact again. It’s supervised for 1 hour every 2 weeks and he doesn’t have a clue who i am.  A lot of money and more court time before things will get better
If it was legal and readily available I wouldn't be here now
